title: NPDev Seed/Mock Data File
description: AppGen-authoring-only convention (definition/seeds/<id>.json), consumed at build time by Build-NpdevApp.ps1 and at runtime by SeedDataService/DataSeedAdminController. Not seen by the model compiler.

id.description: Stable identifier, must match the filename stem (definition/seeds/<id>.json).

kind.description: 'smart' resolves $ref:alias placeholders and expands repeatOver blocks before saving. 'raw' saves every record exactly as written and rejects alias/repeatOver/$ref: usage at load time.

concept.description: Concept name exactly as declared in model.json (matches the generic CRUD REST path's underlying concept, e.g. 'Produto').

alias.description: smart kind only. Optional local name a later record's data can reference via "$ref:<alias>". Only single (non-repeatOver) records may carry an alias.

id.description: raw kind only. Explicit id for this record; if omitted the runner generates one.

data.description: Field values, same shape as a POST /api/<concept> body. In 'smart' mode, a string value of the exact form "$ref:<alias>" is replaced with that alias's generated id.

repeatOver.description: smart kind only. Bulk-generates one record per combination of the declared integer ranges (Cartesian product).
